[[Wikki Tourists F.C.|Wikki Tourist]] (4) | longest unbeaten = [[Abia Warriors F.C.|Abia Warriors]] (10) | longest winless = [[Ikorodu United F.C.|Ikorodu United]] (10) | longest losses = [[Ikorodu United F.C.|Ikorodu United]] (5) | highest attendance = 40,000 El Kanemi at Rangers International | lowest attendance = | average attendance = 8,600 | prevseason = [[2015 Nigeria Professional Football League|2015]] | nextseason = [[2017 Nigeria Professional Football League|2017]] | updated = 2 October 2016 }} The '''2016 Nigeria Professional Football League''' (referred to as the Nigerian [[Globacom|Glo]] premier league for sponsorship reasons) is the 45th season of the [[Nigeria Premier League]], the top Nigerian professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment in 1972, and the 26th since the rebranding of the league as the "Professional League". [[Enugu Rangers]] won their seventh league title and first since 1984. [[Giwa FC|Giwa]], [[Heartland FC|Heartland]], [[Ikorodu United F.C.|Ikorodu United]] and [[Warri Wolves]] finished as the bottom four teams in the standings and will be relegated to [[Nigeria National League]] for the 2017 season. ==Clubs== A total of 20 teams will contest the league including 16 teams from the [[2015 Nigeria Premier League|previous season]] and four teams promoted from the [[Nigeria National League]]. The four promoted teams replace [[Bayelsa United F.C.|Bayelsa United]], [[Kwara United F.C.|Kwara United]], [[Sharks F.C.|Sharks]] and [[Taraba F.C.|Taraba]] who were all relegated to the National
